name: krx-bench-extension
description: KRX-bench-extension extends the original KRX benchmark to evaluate models on Korean financial text tasks, focusing on information extraction, classification, and question answering over stock-market-related documents. It measures models' ability to understand domain-specific terminology, extract entities, and answer finance-related queries in Korean. The dataset contains labeled examples for classification and span/entity extraction to assess both accuracy and robustness.
evaluation_method: accuracy and F1 (and exact_match for span/entity tasks)
reputation: A niche benchmark primarily used in Korean NLP and financial-language research with limited but growing adoption.
